subject: An enzyme may help clear senescent cells from tissue
script: From Agewell Brief: An enzyme may help clear senescent cells from tissue. Scientists are homing in on an enzyme that may help remove senescent cells—the so-called 'zombie' cells that accumulate with age. Here's what the research suggests and what it doesn't. Living longer doesn't always mean living healthier. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
